newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials firm, Nasdaq softer in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials firm, Nasdaq softer in early trade.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks were firmer in early trading on Friday, while the Nasdaq composite, which had a strong showing yesterday, gave back some gains in volatile trading due to index futures and options expiration.

"The market is volatile because of triple witching," Thomas O'Brien, head trader of domestic equities at Guzman & Co, said. "Before the market open, all the imbalances were to the sell side. Then some buy programs kicked in at the open."
The Dow industrials were up around 19 points to 7796 while the Nasdaq composite was off 1.13 points at 1446. The long bond was up 2/32 at a 6.68 percent yield.
